summary.zh: 消息、邮件、文档、日程与待办
summary.en: Messages, mail, docs, schedules, and tasks

description.zh:
安装官方 wecom-cli 后扫码授权，操作企业微信的消息、邮件、文档、日程与待办。
账号授权与 CLI 安装都在插件页面完成。
description.en:
Scan the QR code to authorize the official wecom-cli, then work with WeCom messages, mail, docs, schedules, and tasks.
CLI install and account authorization both happen on the plugin page.
